summary.title: SwiftPay Currency Converter
summary.description: The currency conversion feature allows users to search live exchange rates via a search bar. the backend (Python/flask) queries a MySQL database using user-supplied currency codes. No input sanitization is applied. results are returned as JSON to the frontend

diagrams.title: The currency conversion feature accepts a user‑supplied currency code via an HTTP GET request. The backend Python service concatenates this input directly into an SQL query without sanitisation and returns the query results as JSON.
diagrams.description: STRIDE Threat Analysis – SwiftPay Currency Conversion  1. Spoofing    - An attacker could impersonate another user by manipulating session tokens if the API gateway does not validate authentication properly.    - Severity: Medium  2. Tampering    - The user input (currency code) is directly concatenated into an SQL query. An attacker can modify the input to alter the query logic (e.g., ' OR '1'='1).    - The HTTP request could be intercepted and modified if TLS is not enforced (data‑in‑transit tampering).    - Severity: High  3. Repudiation    - No audit logs are mentioned for search queries. An attacker could deny performing malicious searches.    - Severity: Low  4. Information Disclosure    - SQL injection allows an attacker to dump entire tables (e.g., exchange_rates, users). This is the primary disclosure risk.    - Error messages might reveal database structure if detailed exceptions are returned to the user.    - Severity: Critical  5. Denial of Service    - An attacker could send stacked queries (e.g., '; SLEEP(5); --) to exhaust database connections.    - Malformed inputs might crash the unhardened Python backend.    - Severity: Medium  6. Elevation of Privilege    - If the database connection uses a privileged account (e.g., DBA), SQL injection could lead to administrative access to the database server.    - Stored XSS (via nickname) could execute in an admin's browser, leading to session hijacking and privilege escalation.    - Severity: High
